start.overviewDescription: Learn the Demo context and how to approach its controls.
start.guidance: Begin with the first-skirmish guide. Check which mouse-command convention your settings use before relying on a remembered hotkey. Current-build grouping details remain limited by the available evidence.

economy.overviewDescription: Understand the rigs, roads and trucks behind the economy.
economy.guidance: Oil must reach the HQ. Follow the route from the captured rig through its road and truck movement rather than assuming that owning a rig is enough. The guide separates published logistics principles from unverified rates.

tactics.overviewDescription: Scouting, fog and the limits of old sightings.
tactics.guidance: Use the scouting guide to distinguish what your forces currently observe from an old sighting. Do not treat an old marker or a promotional map as live intelligence.

support.overviewDescription: Specific Demo problems and the evidence behind each answer.
support.guidance: For night visibility, read the dated developer update. For the missing unlimited-oil menu, check the acknowledgement that it was removed. Startup problems are covered with PC requirements and carefully attributed workarounds.

game-info.overviewDescription: Demo access, supported platforms and announced full-game plans.
game-info.guidanceTitle: Know which version you are reading about
game-info.guidance: The main game is planned for January 29, 2027. That does not make the full campaign, editor or February Dead Front mode a current Demo walkthrough. Read the modes page before following a feature claim.

items.question: Which WarFront is this?
items.answer: The pixel RTS by Shu'la Lab LLC, Steam app5344530, where oil is carried along physical roads. This is not the2007 War Front game.

items.question: Does the Chinese site mean the game has official Chinese support?
items.answer: No. These are our editorial translations. The game currently lists English support.

about.intro: WarFront Wiki is an independent fan guide to the oil-and-road strategy game developed by Shu'la Lab LLC. We organize practical questions about the Demo and clearly distinguish announced full-game features.

sections.heading: What this guide covers
sections.body: Our current focus is the first skirmish, controls, oil transport, scouting, visibility and specific reported problems. We link dated official material and identify community reports. A planned feature or a developer acknowledgement is not presented as a tested solution.

sections.heading: Languages and independence
sections.body: The English and Chinese pages are our editorial versions. The game currently lists English support; our Chinese translation does not imply an official Chinese game localization. We are not the developer, publisher or an official support service.

sections.heading: How we handle changes
sections.body: Demo behavior can change. Each guide explains its evidence boundary and records meaningful updates. Tell us the page, game build and source when you find an error. Original diagrams explain concepts; they are not screenshots or measured game simulations.

contact.intro: Contact the WarFront Wiki Team about corrections, broken links, accessibility or this website. For game purchases, account issues and bug reports, use the developer's official channels.

sections.heading: Report a correction
sections.body: Include the affected page URL, what appears incorrect, the Demo or full-game version, and a link to supporting evidence. A short description of what you expected and what happened helps us reproduce navigation or display problems.

sections.heading: Send feedback safely
sections.body: Use the editorial address below. Do not send passwords, payment details, private account information or authentication codes. We cannot recover game accounts or process refunds.

sections.heading: Media and rights inquiries
sections.body: If your inquiry concerns an image, text or other material, identify the exact page and work, explain your connection to it, and provide a way to reply. We review specific requests and correct substantiated mistakes.

privacy-policy.intro: This page explains the information involved in browsing WarFront Wiki and choosing optional advertising or measurement. The quick-help selector works on your device and sends no answers to a server.

sections.heading: Browsing and hosting
sections.body: Our hosting provider may process standard request information such as IP address, requested path, browser and time to deliver and secure the site. We do not require a visitor account to read guides.

sections.heading: Optional ads and measurement
sections.body: When configured, third-party advertising and optional analytics may use cookies or similar storage. The consent controls let you accept or decline these optional loaders. Advertising providers process their own requests under their policies; changing your choice does not delete data already held by a provider.

sections.heading: Local preferences and contact
sections.body: Your browser may save choices such as theme and consent. You can clear site storage using browser settings. Emailing us sends the information you choose to include; provide only what is needed for your inquiry.

terms-of-service.intro: WarFront Wiki provides independent informational guides. Using this website does not create a relationship with Shu'la Lab LLC or grant access to the game.

sections.heading: Use the version context
sections.body: Guides reflect the sources and version context identified on each page. Demo updates, settings and platforms can produce different results. We distinguish verified statements, attributed player observations and unresolved questions.

sections.heading: Permitted use
sections.body: You may read and link to the guides for personal use. Do not interfere with the site, impersonate its operators or submit private credentials. Rights in game material remain with their respective owners.

sections.heading: Corrections and external services
sections.body: External stores, developer pages, videos and advertisements operate independently. Check their own terms before using them. Report a substantive error through our Contact page so we can review the specific claim.

copyright.intro: WarFront and related game names, artwork and other game materials belong to their respective rights holders. This is an independent fan website.

sections.heading: Game and promotional material
sections.body: Official promotional images are used to identify the game and support commentary. They do not establish that we personally tested a strategy or that a pictured feature is available in every Demo build.

sections.heading: Our editorial work
sections.body: Our original explanations, layout and conceptual diagrams are prepared for this guide. A diagram is a reading aid, not an official map, exact pathfinding model or source of undocumented game statistics.

sections.heading: Request a review
sections.body: For a rights inquiry, contact us with the relevant page URL, a description of the work and your authority to act. We review specific requests rather than asking visitors to post sensitive information publicly.

items.label: Oil is not arriving
items.text: Check the captured rig, its connected road, the truck route and the return to HQ. Owning a rig alone does not demonstrate a completed delivery. Exact rates and every pathfinding failure are not verified here.

items.label: The controls feel unfamiliar
items.text: Check the mouse-command convention in Settings before following a key table. Players report different selection/deselection behavior; exact option labels and all grouping hotkeys remain unverified.

items.label: I cannot see clearly at night
items.text: The developer asks players to update to the latest Demo after a night-vision change. This is not proof that every visibility issue is fixed, and the reply does not identify an exact build.

items.label: The unlimited-oil menu vanished
items.text: The developer says the menu was included accidentally and removed. We have no verified supported method to re-enable it; do not follow an old unlock or cheat-menu promise.

items.label: The Demo opens to a blank screen
items.evidence: One player’s report; no universal fix
items.text: Record the hardware, game build, installation location and repeatable symptoms. One Windows player reported a storage-location workaround; that does not establish a general SSD fault or guarantee a fix.

items.label: I am looking for the map editor
items.evidence: Official full-game announcement; Demo access unverified
items.text: The editor/Workshop announcement concerns the full game. Do not infer an accessible current Demo menu from a store tag. Check the release-and-modes page before following editor instructions.
